title: Privatized shared histogram with one atomic flush (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.

128 elements, 8 bins, 4 blocks of 32 threads; graded on both the histogram result and the simulator's races metric (a non-atomic accumulate happens to sum correctly in this simulator's one-thread-at-a-time execution, so races is the metric that actually forces atomics).
